source: russellmitchell only; previously opened development source
episode_rule: Explicit selecting_activity -> target business activity start through explicit return to selecting_activity; entire original activity, not request/flow count.
connection_rule: Full SF Zeek record, complete raw8, wholly inside simulation, not EOF/shutdown; all possible service requests have author-normal labels plus known internal actor active business episode. Shared ownCloud proxy requires bidirectional request-identity coverage and every possible frontend actor normal.
role_rule: No cross-day episode or connection is split. Connected components of episode-flow edges stay together; cross-day/incomplete/conflicting components are unresolved.
quality_filter: No rejection based on truncation, packet-length normalization, packet count, byte count, or model score.
normal_label_scope: Conditional B-grade service-connection normality given complete published log members and actor evidence; no unique client TCP request attribution is implied by coarse Apache seconds.
strata: OwnCloud exact file-transfer request flows distinguished from interface/API workflow flows.
